name: Bathyal-Erg
description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws a binary sunset, patient as erosion itself.
Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Instruments disagree about the radiation hotspot: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
